chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Abi al-Mi'za, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One who regularly recites 'Hasa-aka al-Ghashiyah' (Surah Al-Ghashiyah) in his obligatory or recommended prayers, Allah will envelop him with His mercy in this world and the next, and Allah will grant him safety on the Day of Resurrection from the punishment of the Fire.

key_terms.أَدْمَنَ: Regularly did / made a habit of
key_terms.هَلْ أَتاکَ: Has there reached you (opening phrase of Surah Al-Ghashiyah)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for regularly reciting Surah Al-Ghashiyah in prayer?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this tradition emphasizing the spiritual discipline of habituating oneself to Surah Al-Ghashiyah, linking its recitation in both obligatory and voluntary prayers to comprehensive divine mercy. The promise of 'security from the punishment of Hellfire' (al-amn min 'adhab al-nar) reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that consistent engagement with this surah serves as a protective shield against the specific trials of the grave and resurrection.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Abi al-Mi’za from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

One who regularly recites: Surah Ghashiya in his obligatory and recommended prayers, Allah’s mercy would pervade him in this world as well as the next, and on the Day of Judgment, Allah would keep that man safe and protected from the chastisement of fire.
